help:
agentic-flow-kit v{{version}}

用法：
  flow-kit install --agent <host> [--agent <host>...] [--lang zh-CN|en] [--stack dotnet|node|empty] [--target <dir>] [--dry-run] [--force] [--no-git-config] [--track-hosts]
  flow-kit add-host <host> [--target <dir>] [--dry-run] [--force]
  flow-kit upgrade [--target <dir>] [--dry-run] [--force]
  flow-kit doctor [--target <dir>] [--deep] [--fix]
  flow-kit list-hosts

宿主：trae, codebuddy, claude, opencode, qwen, pi, cline, commandcode, qoder, zcode

示例：
  node cli-tools/agentic-flow-kit/bin/flow-kit.mjs install --agent trae --agent codebuddy --lang zh-CN --target .
